messages:
Sam (support): New customer NewAcct signed up but their project shows no API keys in the console. They hit the Create API key button and it errors. Can someone triage?
Lia (prod-eng): Can you paste the signup/request id and any logs you have? I can look at the provisioner.
Sam (support): Request ID: 04f3a9c2. Created 2026-02-15T14:22:03Z. Customer steps: 1) SSO -> accept invite 2) go to Project > API keys -> nothing shown, 'No credentials' message.
Sam (support): I ran an internal API check: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPPORT_TOKEN" \
  https://internal-api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/pa_04f3a9c2/keys
# result: 404 {"error":"no-credentials"}
```
Onboarder Bot: provisioner:event claim_created id=cl_7b2c9fa status=queued org=na-newacct project_ref=pa_04f3a9c2
Onboarder Bot: provisioner:event processed id=cl_7b2c9fa status=errored reason="project binding lookup failed"
Lia (prod-eng): Paste of provisioner logs please (pop/consume path).
Sam (support): grabbing logs from provisioner consumer (filtered):
```
[2026-02-15T14:22:05Z] INFO claim_queue: pop cl_7b2c9fa
[2026-02-15T14:22:06Z] ERROR binding-service: lookup project by org=na-newacct ref=pa_04f3a9c2 -> 404
[2026-02-15T14:22:06Z] ERROR provisioner: abort claim cl_7b2c9fa reason="project-not-found"
[2026-02-15T14:22:06Z] WARN claim_queue: requeue disabled for transient failures
```
Lia (prod-eng): That matches a race where the project row was created but not yet visible to the binding service (catalog cache lag). Quick remediation: manual bind + force-create key, then follow up with a fix for retry/backoff. Steps: 
1) `rwd-admin projects bind --org na-newacct --project pa_04f3a9c2`
2) `rwd-admin keys create --project pa_04f3a9c2 --label initial-access`
Sam (support): Running step 1...
Sam (support): `> rwd-admin projects bind --org na-newacct --project pa_04f3a9c2` -> "bind: success"
Sam (support): Running step 2... created key id k_5f9d4a. Pasted the key to the customer via DM (redacted). Customer confirms they can now see the key in the console :tada:
Jorge (acct-mgr): Noted — reaching out to NewAcct to explain outage and next steps. Adding credit for time lost.
Lia (prod-eng): I'll open a tiny PR to add exponential retry + metric on binding failures and enable requeue for transient failures (low risk). Also adding a 250ms backoff before the first lookup.
InfraBot: created ticket INF-3421: "provisioner: add retry/backoff for binding lookup" assigned to eng-ml.
Sam (support): Logging incident in support tracker with steps, workaround, and customer contact. Closing once PR lands. Thanks all :thumbsup:
